stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, plus first steps in computational thinking and Python, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading and writing, the sciences and history, plus programming in Python and how computers and the internet work.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra through calculus and statistics, the lab sciences, English and history, plus Python with data and algorithms, and object-oriented programming.

stages.name: College AI and machine learning degree
stages.blurb: The computer science core (programming, discrete mathematics, tools, data structures and algorithms), the mathematics of machine learning (calculus, linear algebra, probability, optimization, statistics and information theory), numerical computing and data science, supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning and its architectures, language, vision, reinforcement learning, causal inference, AI ethics, safety and governance, and machine learning engineering.

stages.name: Graduate study and research in machine learning
stages.blurb: Statistical learning theory, probabilistic and generative models, large language models, interpretability and alignment, research methods, and a research apprenticeship with qualifying-exam preparation.
